name: fleet-core
description: Authored Fleet Core library: staffing (work shape, role, and lens to model and effort), the tier palette and resolver, shared retry and backoff, the run-start intent envelope, the TypeSafe judgment client, and the delegation audit. Consumers receive the modules they declare as build-time bundles.
